lines: NIT Rourkela has launched a Summer Internship Programme with an objective to encourage
ambitious bright B. Tech, B. Arch, Integrated M.Sc., Integrated M.Tech/Dual Degree, MA, M.Sc. and MBA students of different Institutes
in India other than NIT Rourkela to pursue an innovative research and development project
under the guidance of NITR faculties.
Fellowship or other Financial assistance will not be provided.
Laboratory, Library Facilities (without borrowing) and internet facilities.
Medical facility (consultation with doctor at Institute dispensary).
Approximate food and Accommodation cost at NIT Rourkela Hostel: Rs. 7500/- per month
The Internship is available in the following departments:
Depending on availabe projects floated by the repective departments.
The student should be free in the above mentioned period (May 18 to Jul 17, 2026); otherwise he/she should not apply. Request of late joining or early leaving will not be entertained

He/she should have all grade sheets till the previous semesters (Example, if he/she appears for 6th semester examination in April/May 2026, up to 5th semester result should be available at the time of online application)
Any B.E./B. Tech student with a good academic record, who has appeared at least 4th semester examination.
Any B. Arch/Integrated M.Sc./Integrated M.Tech/Dual degree student with a good academic record, who has appeared at least 6th semester examination.
Any M.Sc/MA/MBA student with a good academic record, who has appeared at least 2nd semester examination.
Please submit application on-line. The details will appear in the institute website. NIT Rourkela
. Applicants will have to check the website for SIP - 2026 updates.
